name: evo-racer-ai-lab
description: Watch AI cars learn to race by evolution, fully offline on Windows.
author: Efe Erim

scripts.setup: (if not exist .venv\Scripts\python.exe py -3.13 -m venv .venv) && .venv\Scripts\python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -r requirements-dev.lock && .venv\Scripts\python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-deps --no-build-isolation -e . && npm ci
scripts.lint: prettier . --ignore-path .gitignore --ignore-path .prettierignore --ignore-path .git/info/exclude --check && eslint . --max-warnings 0 && .venv\Scripts\python -m ruff format --check python && .venv\Scripts\python -m ruff check python && .venv\Scripts\python -m mypy python/src python/tests python/tools
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:python && npm run build
